title: Claims output
description: Structured reader output: the atomic claims a model asserts from the selected context, each grounded in one or more context items by id and quote. Optional members are modelled as required-and-nullable so this exact schema can be sent to a strict structured-output provider (OpenAI json_schema strict, Anthropic tool input_schema) without transformation. additionalProperties is false everywhere: an unknown member is a contract violation, never a tolerated extra.

claims.description: Atomic claims in assertion order. Empty when the model abstains.

citations.description: Context items this claim is grounded in. A claim with no citation is not admissible.

item_id.description: Id of a selected context item. An id outside the selected set is a contract violation.

quote.description: Verbatim span of the cited item's text that grounds the claim.

numeric.description: The single checkable quantity the claim asserts, or null for a claim that asserts none. Decimal string, never a float.

abstain.description: Present (non-null) when the model declines to answer from the selected context; claims must then be empty.
